fields.affected: Fire weather zones 070 and 071 in southwest Ohio.
fields.winds: Southwest 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph.
fields.impacts: Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor burning is not recommended.
actions: A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are either occurring now or will shortly. A combination of strong winds, low relative humidity and warm temperatures can contribute to extreme fire behavior.
